text.zh: 一切指令的源头：大脑。860 亿个神经元只占体重的 2%，却消耗全身 20% 的能量。
text.en: Every command starts in the brain — 86 billion neurons, 2% of your weight, 20% of your energy.

text.zh: 颅底藏着豌豆大的垂体——腺体"总司令"，用激素远程指挥生长、代谢与情绪。
text.en: At the skull base hides the pea-sized pituitary — commander of hormones for growth, metabolism and mood.

text.zh: 视神经像两条"视频电缆"，各由一百多万根纤维组成，把眼睛拍到的世界实时传回大脑。
text.en: The optic nerves are twin video cables — over a million fibers each, streaming the world to your brain.

text.zh: 指令沿脊髓一路向下：这条藏在椎骨管道里的"信息高速路"，是大脑与全身之间的必经之路。
text.en: Commands race down the spinal cord — the information highway sheltered inside your vertebrae.

text.zh: 从脊髓出发，信号经周围神经奔向每块肌肉与皮肤——从起念到动指尖，只要百分之一秒。（周围神经的三维数据将在后续版本补充）
text.en: From the cord, signals fan out through peripheral nerves to every muscle — thought to fingertip in a hundredth of a second.
